desc: The ever-popular HOWA Flag Chassis Precision Rifles are now available in a CARBON barrel version in both 6.5 Creedmoor and .308. The continued demand for the Howa Flag Chassis platforms have now evolved into another popular offering for Precision shooting that is lighter and a wonderful precision package out of the box that won’t break the bank for those looking to get into the long range precision shooting game, all while sporting the USA FLAG theme on their setup. Either way you go , these new Carbon offerings not only look great and are also are 1 lb. -8 oz. lighter than previous models and continue to provide the long range shooting applications that many of today’s shooters prefer for a variety of reasons and still adhering to excellent ballistics down range.
